system.description: A fang of black glass blessed in Brask's name, bound to a weapon. Once per day, your next hit with that weapon deals an additional d6 fire damage and d4 persistent fire damage. Expendable d20.
system.lastRite: ◇ Shatter it into the blade: until the end of the encounter, every hit with that weapon deals an additional d6 fire damage and d4 persistent fire damage.
system.drawback: The weapon turns cold in your hand: Bane on your first attack in every combat until it is recovered.
system.faction: the smith-priests of the Obsidian Bastion
